headline: Broadway Market: not taking new trader applications, waiting list open
summary: Hackney Council keeps a waiting list for Broadway Market pitches and contacts traders when a space opens for their type of goods.

headline: Broadway Market's Sunday food market started with a cap of 20 traders
summary: A smaller Sunday market for food traders and florists at our pitch: fewer stalls than Saturday's 150+.

headline: Hackney Church Brew Co welcomes outside suppliers for wedding treat carts
summary: An E8 wedding venue whose listing says outside suppliers are welcome for treat carts; coffee carts aren't mentioned, so it's one to ask about.

headline: London coffee carts get event quote requests through AddToEvent
summary: Event clients post a request and get quotes from several suppliers within hours; London coffee carts already list there.

headline: Film and TV shoots in London hire craft baristas
summary: Productions look for coffee at the unit base early in the morning; craft barista roles are advertised for London shoots.
